integrity: All analytic arguments are included and three standard-library checkers are embedded with their actually generated logs. No claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only complete bipartite graphs; ties always retain incumbent; critical limit needs fixed nonzero finite shore ratio; middle suppression requires palette between m^(3/2) and m^2; fixed-palette reentry holds for fixed q only. Finite enumeration corroborates but does not prove infinite assertions. Historical priority remains qualified.
title: An isolated birthday-scale oscillation peak and reentry in multicolor plurality
